content:
A reliable source with a proven track record of leaks has shared a video that appears to show two new colours of the iPhone 18 Pro on display in a retail store.

The short clip shows what is expected to be a deep cherry colour and a blue, but is almost certainly faked……

The 14-second video shows someone holding a deep cherry-coloured iPhone 18 Pro Max next to a deep blue iPhone 17 Pro Max for comparison, with a light blue model also on the display stand.

The setting looks like a retail store. Macworld believes the footage could be genuine.

But I remain sceptical.

My colleague Fernando Silva has just returned from IFA, and tells me that every phone case company makes very convincing dummy units, so getting hold of these is not difficult at all. Also, the store environment feels suspicious to me. The display table is unreasonably small for a shop, and the product labels look like they are not fixed in place, just propped up at an angle. Nor do we see any convincing shop fittings.

Finally, although this source has a decent track record, recently they have basically just been reposting posts from Chinese social media.
